questions.text: What makes a home comfortable, in your opinion?

questions.text: Describe a TV programme or series you enjoy watching.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a TV programme or series you enjoy watching. You should say: what it is called; what it is about; when and where you watch it; and explain why you enjoy watching it.

questions.text: Do you watch it alone or with other people?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you watch it alone or with other people?

questions.text: What kinds of television programmes are popular in your country?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a TV programme or series you enjoy watching, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all television. What kinds of television programmes are popular in your country?

questions.text: Do you think there is too much advertising on television?
questions.say: Do you think there is too much advertising on television?

questions.text: Should television programmes for children be educational?

questions.text: Why do many people now prefer streaming services to ordinary television?
questions.say: Now let's talk about streaming. Why do many people now prefer streaming services to ordinary television?

questions.text: Is it a problem when people watch a whole series in one day?
questions.say: Is it a problem when people watch a whole series in one day?

questions.text: Do you think traditional television channels will disappear?
